name: Merkava Mk 4 / 4M / Barak
protection: Modular composite armour, front-mounted engine adds protection; Trophy active protection on Mk 4M and Barak. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetration needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon, best against side, rear and engine deck. Trophy (proposal): defeats the first RPG/AT4/NLAW per facing, not top-attack Javelin.
visual_notes: Front-engine hull with a rear clamshell door into a small crew/stretcher bay
Very long, low wedge turret with a sharply pointed nose and large rear bustle
Chain-and-ball curtain hanging under the turret rear
6 road wheels per side behind heavy side skirts
Trophy radar panels and launchers on turret sides (4M/Barak)
Often with roof cope cage / anti-drone screens in 2024-2026
